manyfold3d/manyfold.note: Generative AI policy: "We are highly unlikely to review or accept AI-generated or 'vibe coded' PRs" and considers AI-generated code likely incompatible with their license/CLA.

rizinorg/rizin.note: "Using AI tools to fix issues labelled as 'good first issues' is forbidden" — and the course pool issues for this repo are exactly those. Raised standards for new contributors due to AI-generated contribution volume.

ggml-org/llama.cpp.note: AI Usage Policy: AI-generated code is allowed, but submitting code you don't understand is not — "you are 100% responsible for every line".

ponylang/ponyc.note: AI-assisted contributions welcomed ("we're glad to have you"), with extra responsibilities: use their published LLM skills and review carefully before opening clearly AI-assisted PRs.

scikit-learn/scikit-learn.note: Has a "Low Quality and AI Generated Contributions Policy" and the PR template requires an AI-usage disclosure section.

kubernetes-sigs/cluster-api.note: Allows AI assistance but requires you to respond to review comments without relying on AI tools, and discourages lengthy AI-generated PR descriptions.

academysoftwarefoundation/openimageio.note: AI coding assistants permitted with guidelines: human in the loop and fully able to explain the code, interact yourself (not by agent), and disclose tools via an "Assisted-by:" line in commits/PR.

wesnoth/wesnoth.note: Machine-assisted code accepted only if you can fully explain what it does and why; "vibe coded" PRs you can't explain may be closed immediately.

cortexproject/cortex.note: Has a dedicated Generative AI Contribution Policy (GENAI_POLICY.md) that contributors using AI tools must review.

apache/airflow.note: PR template requires disclosing whether generative AI tooling was used to co-author the PR.

stdlib-js/stdlib.note: PR template requires an AI-assistance disclosure (e.g. "This PR was written primarily by Claude Code.") so reviewers can calibrate scrutiny.

carlos-emr/carlos.note: Explicitly supports AI-assisted development: ships Claude Code configuration (.claude/) and Copilot instructions for contributors.
